ai_summary: Apcotex Industries Limited has completed a strategic acquisition of a 1.275% equity stake in Amplus Ampere Private Limited for INR 7.2 million. This investment is specifically for the captive consumption of solar power, enhancing Apcotex's access to renewable energy. The target entity, a relatively new SPV that only recently began generating significant revenue, appears to be a minor, operationally aligned acquisition with no immediate red flags.
